# github_enterprise_team (Data Source)

Looks up an enterprise team by slug.

## Example

```hcl
data "github_enterprise_team" "example" {
  provider = github-enterprise

  enterprise_slug = "my-enterprise"
  slug            = "ent:platform"
}
```

## Schema

| Attribute | Type | Requirement | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | `String` | Read-only | Team description. |
| `enterprise_slug` | `String` | Required | Enterprise account slug. |
| `group_id` | `String` | Read-only | Linked IdP group ID, or an empty string. |
| `id` | `String` | Read-only | enterprise_slug/team_id. |
| `name` | `String` | Read-only | Team name. |
| `notification_setting` | `String` | Read-only | Mention notification mode. |
| `organization_selection_type` | `String` | Read-only | Organization selection mode. |
| `slug` | `String` | Required | Team slug returned by GitHub, including ent: when present. |
| `team_id` | `Number` | Read-only | Numeric team ID. |

See the [provider guide](https://github.com/vmvarela/terraform-provider-github-enterprise#authentication) for authentication, ownership and compatibility requirements.
